full_inspection: All four native halves of sites044 and120 were read and compared completely, including every marginal and interlinear region. The montage audit_120_T_compare.jpg directly compares the three script-T contours and the overlapping p in soupçonne. All five special rounded glyphs were separately inspected. The complete body, note1, printed42 and six underlines otherwise agree.
original_transcription_comparison: The exact original page transcriptions differ only in foliation. Both omit hand wrappers on the three distinct freehand script-Ts and impose mathcal A on five repeated rounded typed glyphs. The direct four-image comparison establishes the separately recorded shared-hand and uncertain-alphabet outcomes; remaining readings match.
